description: Tier A-narrow. For repos whose pull_request CI is a build or a lint, not a test suite —
roma-aeterna (astro check + link check + build), krtffl.dev (hugo build), torrons-infra
A build that compiles proves the dependency still type-checks. It does not prove the page still
renders correctly, and for the site repos a merge to main deploys straight to Cloudflare. So the
automerge scope here stops at things that cannot reach a visitor: CI action versions, dev-only
packages, and lockfile refreshes. Production dependencies — even patches — get a human.
Promote a repo from this preset to :automerge once it has a test job that would fail on a bad

packageRules.description: CI action versions and digests. A broken action fails the next workflow run and never reaches a visitor.
Dev-only npm tooling: linters, formatters, test runners, type packages.
0.x minors are breaking under semver even in dev tooling.
Majors are always a human decision.
Runtime dependencies ship to visitors. A build passing is not evidence the site is still correct.
Nothing docker is automerged — no repo builds its image on a pull_request.
